description: Horaires théoriques et temps réel du réseau de transport Marineo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération du Boulonnais. Theoretical timetables in GTFS format and real-time timetables in GTFS-RT format of buses of the Marineo network circulating on the territory of the agglomeration of Boulonnais (Boulogne-sur-Mer). Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération du Boulonnais. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical timetables and real time of the Marineo transport network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'agglomération du Boulonnais. Its keywords include gtfs, transport, transport-public, horaires-et-itineraires, horaires-theoriques, horaires. The listing shows 4 download or service links in SIRI, GTFS, GTFS-RT. The listing shows 2025-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
